summary: Completed Phase 3+4 testing for economy, admin, settings, and dark mode features. All 38 backend API tests and all frontend UI tests passed. NO AI generation triggered (cost constraint respected).

GET /api/me/economy returns plan=free, credits=30, creations_remaining=3 for fresh user
Admin gating: normal user gets 403, admin gets 200 on GET /api/admin/overview
GET /api/config/models returns 403 for normal user, 200 for admin (admin-only endpoint)
Redeem code lifecycle: admin creates code, normal user redeems successfully, second redeem fails with 400, invalid code fails with 400
Economy updates after redeem: plan=creator, credits=130, creations_remaining=None
Admin user management: list users, change user plan via PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}
Admin jobs list (GET /api/admin/jobs)
Admin codes list (GET /api/admin/codes)
Dev-login UI flow via LoginModal (signin-btn -> login-modal -> dev-login-email -> dev-login-button)
Settings page has NO AI model/provider selection UI (AI Preferences correctly removed)
Dark mode toggle on /settings (data-testid settings-darkmode-toggle) toggles .dark class on <html>
Dark mode toggle in header (data-testid theme-toggle-button) toggles theme
Dark mode persists to localStorage (khova_theme key)
Credits pill in header (data-testid credits-pill, credits-pill-value) displays user balance
Economy view on /settings shows plan badge, credits value, creations remaining
Redeem code input functional on /settings (data-testid settings-redeem-input, settings-redeem-button)
Normal user visiting /admin sees 'Admin only' forbidden message (403)
Admin user can access /admin dashboard with stat cards (users, jobs, active codes, credits consumed)
Admin dashboard has Users/Redeem Codes/Generation Jobs tabs
Admin can create redeem code via form (data-testid admin-create-code-button)
Admin users table displays correctly
Admin codes table displays correctly
